etsy.description:
Everything your kids need for a calm, screen-free Christmas break, in one download.

WHAT'S INSIDE (76 pages, US Letter + A4 PDF)
PART 1 – Christmas Coloring Pages (28 pages)
• 24 bold, easy holiday coloring pages + color test page + certificate
PART 2 – Christmas Activity Book (48 pages)
• 10 mazes, 8 word searches, 8 dot-to-dot pictures, tracing pages, 12 more coloring pages, letter to Santa, certificate

BUNDLE VALUE: both sets together for less than buying them separately.

PERFECT FOR
• Families with kids ages 2–8 (siblings!)
• Winter break, travel days, classroom parties

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Print at home or at a print shop, as many times as you need for your family.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
